steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and lightly oil a 23 x 33 cm baking dish.
Peel and dice the eggplant into 1 cm cubes; finely chop the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook the onion for 3 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and ground turkey; cook for 5 minutes, breaking up the meat, until no pink remains.
Stir in the tomato paste, oregano, and crushed tomatoes; cook for 2 minutes.
Add the eggplant cubes, rice, and vegetable broth; stir to combine evenly.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish and spread into an even layer.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes, until the rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove the foil and bake for a further 5 minutes until the top is lightly set.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving. Keeps refrigerated for 3 days or frozen up to 2 months. Yields 4 family portions.
